column3: Review sump locations, slopes, bunded area requirements, drains and routing.
Access requirements under vessels (grillages, drains, piping etc)
Requirements for equipment maintenance within buildings, lifting, roof openings, road access.
Contract access requirements, equipment, man ways and instruments (stairways/ladders/platforms)
Pipe racks and cable tray routings and sizing
Structural requirements for equipment maintenance (spare pump racks, support for overhead cranes)
Clarify materials and paint specification for structures, stairways, ladders and walkways.
Access to vessel man ways and instruments
Maintenance access for heat exchanger tubes and or plates
Access for maintenance and replacement of filters, cells, de-misting elements strainers etc.
Crane access for equipment replacement, catalyst screening and major maintenance work
Maintenance access to equipment, vessels, blowers, fans and pumps
Location and access to, Safety Showers
Ensure adequate provision for dealing with solid and liquid waste products from filters, strainers, sumps and drains.
Check scope and location of in-line and stand-by spares
Major Pipe and ducting runs defined
Check pipe rack elevations, locations and battery limits
Check valve locations and their access for operation and maintenance
Consider layout of large gas ducting runs to minimize elbows and bends for pressure drop reduction
Check pipe and ducting material specifications
Consider support philosophy for large ducts with the objective of minimizing separate support duct towers
Consider pipe runs for access and removal of  equipment valves and other instruments

Take special consideration of layout and design of piping systems which contain fluids with suspended solids that can settle and block the piping. Ensure adequate straight runs and flanges for cleaning blocked pipes, long radius elbows etc.
Ensure sumps and drains are fully defined
Location and access to MCC, switchgear, termination panels
Location and routing of cable trays
Review location of lighting and compliance with client specification
Review location and access to field control panels for rotating equipment, burners, pre-heaters, ESPs, etc
Review Control room location, access and cable routing to DCS. Review DCS cabinet locations including marshalling and field control. Review DCS operator and Engineering control stations
Fire water, potable water and sewer lines location
